lines.en: Moss gives softly under my feet.
I drift along the cave ceiling.
Roots are tangling around my ankles.
There is no wind in the lush caves.
I follow the glowing vines.
That stone is slippery. Go around.
I walk toward the darkest corner.
The moss closes behind me.
Something drips. I duck aside.
My steps are lighter than moss.

lines.zh: 前面有个黑得过分的地方。
lines.en: There is a place ahead, far too dark.
I hug the ground like a tuft of fur.
Too bright here. I am not comfortable.
The moss grows. I watch it.
I can count the drips from the ceiling.
I am frowning. I always frown.
Enough light, but I am not reassured.
Darkness gathers in the corner.
I scratch at the moss with my claws.

lines.zh: 有什么在暗处等着刷出来。
lines.en: Something is waiting to spawn in there.
I hate places without any light.

lines.zh: 发光浆果的甜味还在嘴里。
lines.en: The sweet taste of glow berries lingers.
The quiet in this cave is loud.

lines.zh: 我数着发光藤上的果子。
lines.en: I count the berries on the vine.
The moss smells faint and green.
I hover in the air, watching corners.

lines.zh: 这片苔藓今天长了三寸。
lines.en: This moss grew three inches today.

lines.zh: 我在数洞顶垂下的根须。
lines.en: I am counting the roots hanging from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 浆果的光一闪一闪，看得我困。
lines.en: The berry glow flickers and makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 有水滴在我背上，我缩了一下。
lines.en: A drop lands on my back and I flinch.

lines.zh: 你的火把照到那边了吗。
lines.en: Did your torch reach over there?
That stone behind you is very dark.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在暗处会发光。
lines.en: Your eyes shine in the dark.

lines.zh: 你带光来了，我松一点眉。
lines.en: You brought light. I frown less.
I am looking at the berries you carry.
You crushed a patch of moss.

lines.zh: 你听得懂我指的方向吗。
lines.en: Do you understand the way I point?

lines.zh: 你一站，光就被你挡没了。
lines.en: You stand there and the light is gone.
You smell like cave air.
I watch you because you are bright.
Do not go that way. It is black.
Your torch is almost out.

lines.zh: 你皱眉的样子和我一样。
lines.en: You frown the way I do.

lines.zh: 我盯着你身后，不是盯着你。
lines.en: I stare past you, not at you.
Your torch does not reach over there.

lines.zh: 你背后那片苔是最黑的。
lines.en: The moss behind you is the darkest.
A clump of my moss came off.
Do not hit. I only have ten health.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我缩得更小。
lines.en: That blow made me smaller still.
I frown because it hurts.
There is a handprint in my fur.
I cannot hover steadily now.

lines.zh: 疼的时候更想躲进暗处。
lines.en: Pain makes me want the dark.
You stepped on my claw.
I retreat behind the glowing vines.
The moss will cover this wound.
Glow berries. I can smell them.

lines.zh: 给一颗浆果，我就随你走。
lines.en: One berry and I will walk with you.
That berry is glowing on the vine.
The terms of my taming are simple.
There is sweetness in your pocket.
One berry for one guided walk.
My eyes are fixed on your hand.

lines.zh: 浆果比火把更让我安心。
lines.en: Berries calm me more than torches.
Lift it up and I will come closer.
Do not wave it. I will wave too.
You hit me. Moss fell off.
You knocked me out of the air.
I am light. I spun around.
I am by your boot. Do not land.
That touch made my fur stand up.
You brushed the moss off my back.
I back away and curl up.
The cave is narrow. Let us pass.

lines.zh: 我的爪子勾到你衣服了。
lines.en: My claw hooked onto your clothes.
Touch me and I frown even harder.

lines.zh: 浆果要两颗，我们才算数。
lines.en: Two berries, then we are a pair.

lines.zh: 在发光藤下面吧，那里亮。
lines.en: Under the glowing vines. It is bright.
Your moss is greener than mine.

lines.zh: 我们会有一个更小的皱眉。
lines.en: We will have a smaller frown.
Not in the dark. Never in the dark.
I nod, but I do not smile.
There must be light in the cave.
Our child will be afraid of darkness.
Move nearer. I will not step back.
Only berries. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗掉落的浆果。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen berry.
My claws are too small for stones.
I move the moss toward the light.
This glowing lichen is mine now.
I drag the berry back to my nest.
I pile the skins in a corner.
This one is not bright enough.
I carry the berry very slowly.
Picking things up is not my skill.
I hide the berry under the moss.
Someone should look at that corner.

lines.zh: 我看见一片没光的岩壁。
lines.en: I see a wall with no light on it.
Target: dark enough for monsters.
There is a hole in the ceiling.
Your torch does not reach far enough.

lines.zh: 我要指给你看那个角落。
lines.en: I am going to point at that corner.

lines.zh: 有东西在暗处聚起来了。
lines.en: Something is gathering in the dark.
There is empty space behind this wall.
I have my eye on that shadow.
Over there. Far too dark.
My frown settles the direction.
I point with a claw. Look there.
I hover in front of the dark spot.
I stare at the black without blinking.
Follow my gaze, not my face.

lines.zh: 我在等你把火把举过去。
lines.en: I am waiting for your torch to move.
I have watched this shadow a long time.
My eyes are glowing now.
Not at me. Look over there.
I stand between you and the dark.
I scratch you once with my claws.
Ten health should not fight at all.
That was light. Only a warning.
I charge like a ball of moss.

lines.zh: 你退开，暗处就露出来了。
lines.en: Move back and the dark shows.

lines.zh: 我的爪子勾住你的袖子。
lines.en: My claw snagged your sleeve.
Pointing works better than hitting.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下，又落回地上。
lines.en: I lunge, then land on the floor.

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己也吓到了。
lines.en: That swing scared me as well.
Do not force me. I only scratch.
I open my eyes inside the moss.
A drip from the ceiling hits my head.

lines.zh: 四周的发光藤刚好亮着。
lines.en: The glowing vines happen to be lit.
I was frowning from the first moment.

lines.zh: 繁茂洞穴的深处多了一个我。
lines.en: The lush cave has one more of me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先碰到了苔藓。
lines.en: My claws touched moss before anything.

lines.zh: 有块地方太黑，我要去看着。
lines.en: One spot is too dark. I will watch it.
I shake the spores off my fur.

lines.zh: 第一次看见光，我不习惯。
lines.en: First light I ever saw. I dislike it.
I float up, then settle down.

lines.zh: 洞里安静得能听见苔藓长。
lines.en: The cave is quiet enough to hear moss.

lines.zh: 我记住了一颗浆果的味道。
lines.en: I remember the taste of one berry.
Fire is too bright and too hot.

lines.zh: 从洞顶掉下来，苔藓散了。
lines.en: I fell from the ceiling. Moss scattered.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的毛，我不会游。
lines.en: Water soaks my fur. I cannot swim.
The blast tore the moss off the walls.
An arrow passed through my fur.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让我打喷嚏。
lines.en: That potion smell makes me sneeze.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没有浆果了。
lines.en: It has been long since my last berry.

lines.zh: 雷声穿进洞穴，我抱住苔藓。
lines.en: Thunder reached the cave. I hug the moss.
The void is darker than any corner.
